svg.title: Left: a U-shaped curve of the loss function against a weight value, with an arrow to its lowest point labeled minimum loss and good weight value. Right: the error surface of a linear neuron with two input weights, drawn as a mesh bowl over the w1-w2 plane from -5 to 5, with error E rising from 0 at the center to 50 at the corners and circular contours on the floor.
